summary: Independently replayed the committed contention barrier and ordinary deterministic pin race, verified the real two-worker GitHub canary artifact-by-artifact, then integrated an explicit opt-in timing-only barrier into PORTFOLIO_PIN_PROTOCOL_V1 v1.2 and bound a Live projection contract for waiting/released/winner/collision/timeout states. Ordinary portfolio allocation remains direct-to-pin unless durable fixture metadata explicitly opts into barrier mode.
tests: EXACT_BLOB_REPLAY_PASS: contention_start_barrier_v1.mjs exit 0; 2-worker and 5-worker barrier races plus timeout semantics pass.
EXACT_BLOB_BACKCOMPAT_PASS: portfolio_pin_race_v1.mjs exit 0; ordinary direct deterministic races/recovery/legacy winner remain unchanged.
REAL_GITHUB_CANARY_PASS: two distinct entrants, one no-authority RELEASE, exactly one G1 winner + matching sole claim, one genuine loser collision receipt, no loser claim.
BINDING_SCOPE_PASS: barrier mode is explicit opt-in and ordinary jobs remain direct deterministic pin races.
LIVE_PROJECTION_PASS: WAITING_FOR_CONTENDERS, RELEASED_TO_RACE, WINNER, COLLISION_LOSER and TIMEOUT are defined as projections that cannot override durable authority.
truth_boundary: DONE binds this CANARY allocation/projection contract only. It does not promote Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w.
